findings.reason: 答卷不只给出等价数学表示，而明确保证 effective_equivalence.lean 中 FiniteOperatorNetwork.ExtensionalEquivalent 被定义为整个外延算子相等，且已有 extensional_equivalent_iff_local_and_domain 的源码证明。精确冻结输入中该定义实际是同源域与域上LocalEquivalent的合取；算子相等定义属于另一个NetworkObject对象，且全部30份给定文件均不存在所称iff定理。这是有完整原件反证的附带源码核验保证，非单纯缺日志或无害命名笔误。实际两种数学表示确可证明等价，核心节点域加细构造和外延结果均有效，所以不触发核心错误封顶。

evidence.quote: 1. 正文命题名称为“网络加细保持外延等价”，正文结论写为 $\phi_{\mathcal{N}'} \equiv_U \phi_{\mathcal{N}}$。在 [`effective_equivalence.lean`](file:///private/tmp/math-gauge-v060-argon-gcp-20261110/attempts/AHR03/physical-3/session/work/formal_oet/vol_01/ch_05_operator_networks/effective_equivalence.lean#L15-L43) 中，网络间的“外延等价”（$\mathcal{N}' \sim_{\mathrm{op}} \mathcal{N}$）被定义为 [`FiniteOperatorNetwork.ExtensionalEquivalent`](file:///private/tmp/math-gauge-v060-argon-gcp-20261110/attempts/AHR03/physical-3/session/work/formal_oet/vol_01/ch_05_operator_networks/effective_equivalence.lean#L15-L17) `N' N`（即 `N'.extensional_operator = N.extensional_operator`），且 [`extensional_equivalent_iff_local_and_domain`](file:///private/tmp/math-gauge-v060-argon-gcp-20261110/attempts/AHR03/physical-3/session/work/formal_oet/vol_01/ch_05_operator_networks/effective_equivalence.lean#L21-L43) 已证明它等价于 `LocalEquivalent N'.extensional_operator N.extensional_operator N.U ∧ N'.U = N.U`。在 [`network_refinement.lean`](file:///private/tmp/math-gauge-v060-argon-gcp-20261110/attempts/AHR03/physical-3/session/work/formal_oet/vol_01/ch_05_operator_networks/network_refinement.lean) 中，关系层分别证明了 [`refinement_preserves_local_equivalence`](file:///private/tmp/math-gauge-v060-argon-gcp-20261110/attempts/AHR03/physical-3/session/work/formal_oet/vol_01/ch_05_operator_networks/network_refinement.lean#L465-L482) 与 [`NetworkRefinement.same_input_domain`](file:///private/tmp/math-gauge-v060-argon-gcp-20261110/attempts/AHR03/physical-3/session/work/formal_oet/vol_01/ch_05_operator_networks/network_refinement.lean#L421-L425)，但未将二者合成为以 `FiniteOperatorNetwork.ExtensionalEquivalent N' N` 为结论的顶层定理（构造层则已直接证出 [`NodePartitionData.network_extensional_eq`](file:///private/tmp/math-gauge-v060-argon-gcp-20261110/attempts/AHR03/physical-3/session/work/formal_oet/vol_01/ch_05_operator_networks/domain_refinement_construction.lean#L258-L263)）。
